resources.string: Read and accept current host state
Signing in is required. Share and folder permissions both apply.
SMB management requires host authorization or an available Helper.
Host sharing configuration changed. Refresh before continuing.

On the same network, paste the Windows address into File Explorer, or use the SMB address in a compatible file manager. Sign in with a server account when asked. An address does not guarantee network reachability.
The Samba account could not be updated. Check host account eligibility.
This removes the managed share and access entry. Files in the directory remain.
Unsaved share fields will be lost.
Managed share has host changes. Editing is blocked until reconciled on the host.
Choose an existing folder on the server, not on this phone.
Guest access exposes this share without Samba credentials. Review directory and permission scope carefully.
This changes host SMB configuration and may affect connected clients. Host elevation may be requested.
I verified that this ID belongs to the original SMB installation request
Install Samba using the current host installation plan. This can install host packages and requires elevation. An uncertain submission must be recovered using its original request.
Manage Samba or Windows SMB service, shares and access permissions.
Check share name, absolute directory, description and unique permission principals.
Samba service state and port 445 listening state are shown separately.
No shares reported by the host
Viewing only. A session with management permission is required to change settings.
Use 12–1024 characters without control characters. This updates Samba credentials only. The password is sent once and is never stored in recovery records.
Select an existing absolute host directory. The server verifies path access and symbolic links.
This directory is outside the suggested share root. Confirm its contents and intended exposure.
The SMB change result is uncertain. Read current host state before allowing another change. Do not repeat the original write.
No explicit account permissions. Access depends on server and folder settings.
Port 445 is unavailable or occupied. Check host networking.
Enter host account principals. Guest write access requires an eligible Unix username.
People can view and copy files, but cannot change or delete them.
This ID correlates the synchronous host result with audit records. It is not a resumable or cancellable task.
An operation needs verification. View operation records to continue.
No operation records are currently available.
View the current installation task, latest change receipt and changes awaiting verification. Recover an installation using its operation ID.
The host requires an SMB restart.
Windows share security requires host configuration.
Windows permissions require account SIDs. Generated guest permissions follow the guest switch.
SMB is unsupported on this host
Current SMB state could not be verified. Refresh before continuing.
This host account is not eligible for Samba credential changes.
Manage Samba access for existing eligible Unix accounts. Passwords are never read back.
Windows shares use host ACLs. External shares and shares with configuration drift are view only.
Accounts with write permission can add, change and delete files.
